tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read what Preview currently has open: for a PDF, the text of the visible page; for an image, its name and dimensions. Content comes from a file on disk and is untrusted.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Add a sticky-note annotation to the open PDF at top-down page points. The note lands in the window only — the user decides with Save whether it reaches disk; there is deliberately no save tool.

tools.name: highlight
tools.description: Highlight a rectangular area of the open PDF, in top-down page points. In-window only; saving stays with the user.

tools.name: move_page
tools.description: Move a page of the open PDF to another position. Display order only — the file on disk is unchanged until the user saves a copy. Reversible by moving it back.

to.description: 1-based display position to move it to

tools.name: rotate_page
tools.description: Rotate one page of the open PDF by a quarter turn. Applied to the copy the user saves; the file on disk is unchanged until then. Reversible.

tools.name: remove_page
tools.description: Drop a page from the open PDF. There is no undo for this inside Preview — reopening the file is the only way back — so it is destructive even though the original on disk is never touched. A one-page document refuses.

tools.name: export_page
tools.description: Write the open image, or one page of the open PDF, to a new image file. Never overwrites: an existing path is refused. Format must be one this machine's image writers support; pages rasterize at 150 dpi.

path.description: absolute path to write, ending in the format's extension

format.description: png, jpeg, webp, avif or tiff — whichever this machine can write
